{{Top|leg}}
The '''Emperor''' of the [[Tapani Empire]] was the hereditary ruler of the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] during the Dynastic Era (5,392-11,138). The first Emperor was the warrior [[Prince/Legends|prince]] [[Shey Tapani]] of [[House Melantha]], who [[Unification War|unified]] the [[Tapani Noble Houses|Noble Houses]] through a number of [[Blood/Legends|bloody]] [[civil war]]s that lasted nearly twenty years. The last Emperor, of the [[Kappela Dynasty]], fell to a military coup in 11,138 that followed a gentle and steady decline into regional factionalism.
